vilegard_shop_notrust_2.m: I don't trust you. You should go see Jolnor in the chapel if you want some sympathy.

vilegard_shop_notrust_smith.m: You are an outsider. We don't like outsiders here in Vilegard. Please leave.
r: Why is everyone in Vilegard so suspicious of outsiders?
Can I see what items you have for sale?
I have a shipment of Feygard items for you.
On the body of something called the Hira'zinn, I found this peculiar sword. Do you know anything about it?

vilegard_smith_1.m: Hello there. I heard you helped us here in Vilegard. What can I help you with?
r: Can I see what items you have for sale?
I have a shipment of Feygard items for you.
On the body of something called the Hira'zinn, I found this peculiar sword. Do you know anything about it?

vilegard_smith_fg_1.m: Oh, this is most unexpected but very welcome. I will not question how you acquired these items, but instead express my gratitude for bringing them to me.

vilegard_smith_fg_2.m: Thank you for bringing me these items, they will be most useful to us here in the southern lands, and Vilegard in particular. We rarely get our hands on Feygard items, so these are really welcome.
r: I was sent to deliver these items to a Feygard patrol stationed in the Foaming Flask tavern.

vilegard_smith_fg_3.m: Instead, you brought them to me. You have my thanks.

vilegard_smith_fg_4.m: Hah, this means that we have another opportunity here. What if you were to deliver some other items to the Feygard patrol instead? Hah, this will really make my day.

vilegard_smith_fg_5.m: I might have something that will do just fine... Let me just find them.

vilegard_smith_fg_6.m: Here they are. Ha ha, these will do just fine for those deceiving Feygard snobs.

vilegard_smith_fg_7.m: Take these items and deliver them to wherever you were supposed to deliver the items you gave me.

vilegard_smith_xul_1.m:
[Takes a step back]
What ... is ... that? It can't be? No. Let me look at it.

vilegard_smith_xul_10.m: The original sword had ornaments of rare crystals, and a blade that was as sharp as nothing else.

vilegard_smith_xul_11.m: I can't believe I'm telling you this. Give. It. Here. Now! It needs to be destroyed!
r: Here it is. We had better get rid of it.
How about you get to work on restoring it, and I won't kill you.

vilegard_smith_xul_12.m: I ... what? Are you threatening me?
r: You won't believe what I had to go through to get it.

vilegard_smith_xul_13.m: Sigh. You don't know what you are getting yourself into, kid.

vilegard_smith_xul_14.m: Regardless, to restore the sword to its former shape, I'd need some of those crystals that it was adorned with, and those crystals are really hard to come by.

vilegard_smith_xul_15.m: I think they are called Oegyth or something like that. The sword had three of them on its hilt.
r: Never mind. Here is the sword. We had better destroy it.
I'll go find some of those crystals.
I have three of those crystals right here.

vilegard_smith_xul_16.m: Pfft. Run along now, and don't threaten anyone else, you hear?

vilegard_smith_xul_17.m: You continue to amaze me. Now, are you really sure that you want to do this? The lives of the people that it has slain will haunt you.
r: I'm sure. Here is the sword and three of those crystals. Restore it to how it once was.
Never mind. Here is the sword. We had better destroy it.

vilegard_smith_xul_19.m:
Sigh. OK, whatever you say. We just need to fit these into there, and sharpen up this bit here.
There. It should be almost like it once was.

vilegard_smith_xul_2.m: It has all the markings. But it can't be? I don't understand.

vilegard_smith_xul_3.m: This thing that you have stumbled upon, my friend. This is the Xul'viir. A most foul item indeed.

vilegard_smith_xul_4.m: It has been said that King Luthor destroyed the sword so that it would not fall into the wrong hands.

vilegard_smith_xul_5.m: It would seem that either he, or the stories have not been telling the truth.

vilegard_smith_xul_6.m: If restored, anyone wielding it would make their enemies tremble from only the sight of it.

vilegard_smith_xul_7.m: You must destroy it, of course. Here, put it into my smelting pit and we'll be rid of it.
r: Here it is. We had better get rid of it.

vilegard_smith_xul_8.m: Into the smelting pit with it. Good. See how it bubbles and flares? That's the lives of countless people thanking you for destroying it.

vilegard_smith_xul_9.m: You can't be serious. It needs to be destroyed!
r: Here it is. We had better get rid of it.
You mentioned restoring it before, what would that entail?

xulviir.10: I was told that the broken sword that I found on the body of the Hira'zinn should be taken to the smith in Vilegard.
xulviir.20: I have restored the Xul'viir. I had to threaten the smith in Vilegard to get it restored.

feygard_shipment.10: I met Gandoren, the guard captain at the Crossroads guardhouse. He told me about some trouble up in Loneford, that have forced the guards to be even more alert than usual. Because of this, they can't do their regular errands themselves but need help with some basic things.
feygard_shipment.20: Gandoren wants me to help him transport a shipment of 10 iron swords to another guard post to the south.
feygard_shipment.21: I have agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment, as a service for Feygard.
feygard_shipment.22: I have grudgingly agreed to help Gandoren transport the shipment.
feygard_shipment.25: I should deliver the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain stationed in the Foaming Flask tavern.
feygard_shipment.26: Gandoren tells me that Ailshara has expressed some interest in the Feygard shipments, and urges me to stay away from her.
feygard_shipment.30: Ailshara is indeed interested in the shipment, and wants me to help Nor City with the supplies instead.
feygard_shipment.35: If I want to help Ailshara and Nor City, I should deliver the shipment to the smith in Vilegard instead.
feygard_shipment.50: I have delivered the shipment to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.55: I have delivered the shipment to the smith in Vilegard.
feygard_shipment.56: The Vilegard smith gave me a shipment of degraded items that I should deliver to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern instead of the normal ones.
feygard_shipment.60: I have delivered the shipment of degraded items to the Feygard patrol captain in the Foaming Flask tavern. I should go tell Gandoren in the Crossroads guardhouse that the shipment is delivered.
feygard_shipment.80: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment.
feygard_shipment.81: Gandoren thanked me for helping him deliver the shipment. He never suspected anything. I should also report back to Ailshara.
feygard_shipment.82: I have reported back to Ailshara.

vilegard.10: The people of Vilegard are very suspicious of outsiders. I was told to go see Jolnor in the Vilegard chapel if I want to gain their trust.
vilegard.20: I have talked to Jolnor in the Vilegard chapel. He suggests I help three influential people in order to gain the trust of the people in Vilegard. I should help Kaori, Wrye and Jolnor in Vilegard.
vilegard.30: I have helped all three people in Vilegard that Jolnor suggested. Now the people of Vilegard should trust me more.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
